budget_context: campaign limit 14 CPU-hours; this stage would use about 1.4-1.6 CPU-hours (planning, with margin)
data: label-free: REAL MODEL_FIT features (admitted 145-column X, 20,000 people, 13,337 households) with INVENTED labels: occupation sampled from the admitted T_TREE S0 occupation probabilities, income sampled from the H3 S0 income probabilities, SEX drawn from a logistic model in WKHP and teacher probabilities; no label file was opened and no access-log line was written

assumptions: inner-CV HGB fits always run to max_iter = 1000 (early stopping off), so the witness cost hardly depends on the labels; real-label T* (154-168 at 20,000) only lengthens the refits slightly
the correction benchmark used the admitted T_TREE S0 routing with T = 800 trees (the CatBoost cap): real nested teachers have T <= 800, so the correction figures are upper bounds in T
the fixed recipe (20 epochs x 40 steps x 256 rows, 80 warm critic rounds, 5 critic rounds per update) makes the correction cost nearly independent of n (18,005 vs 20,000 rows measured 26 s vs 25 s)
CatBoost tree counts with real labels may differ from the invented-label count (714); <= 800 trees bounds it
